sections.heading: Grading and Drainage Work That Solves Water Problems
sections.body: Standing water, muddy access, poor slope, and soft ground usually point back to how water moves across the property. Bellhouse handles land grading and drainage work for homeowners, builders, farms, and contractors who need practical site shaping, ditching, and drainage prep across Brantford, Paris, Brant County, and nearby Southern Ontario communities.

sections.heading: When Bellhouse Is the Right Fit
sections.subheading: Best fit for grading and drainage work where water control, machine access, and the next phase of construction all need to be considered together.

cards.title: Properties with standing water or soft areas
cards.body: A good fit when water sits in the yard, driveway, lane, or work area after rain and the fix needs more than a surface touch-up.
cards.outcome: Helps reshape the site so water has a better path to move instead of collecting where people, vehicles, or equipment need to work.

cards.title: Driveways, lanes, and building lots
cards.body: Useful when a driveway, shop site, garage pad, or building lot needs slope correction, base prep, or drainage before gravel, concrete, or construction begins.
cards.outcome: Creates a more stable surface for base material, finish grading, and the crews that follow.

cards.title: Contractor-led grading and drainage scopes
cards.body: A strong fit for projects that need excavation, trucking, stone, pipe bedding, and grading coordinated around an active job schedule.
cards.outcome: Keeps water-control work tied to the broader site plan instead of becoming a separate cleanup problem later.

sections.heading: Land Grading & Drainage Scope
sections.subheading: Practical site work for better water movement, stronger access, and cleaner handoff to the next phase.

items.title: Rough & Finish Grading
items.body: We shape yards, lots, lanes, and working areas to establish usable grades and direct water away from problem spots.

items.title: Drainage Swales & Ditching
items.body: Swales and ditches are cut or reshaped to give runoff a controlled path across the site.

items.title: Drain Tile, Pipe & Stone Bedding Prep
items.body: Where underground drainage is part of the scope, we can excavate, bed pipe, place stone, and backfill to support the system.

items.title: Driveway & Access Regrading
items.body: Soft or poorly draining driveways and access routes can be reshaped and prepared for granular base.

items.title: Topsoil, Fill & Aggregate Movement
items.body: Bellhouse can move, place, and shape imported or on-site material so grading and drainage work stay coordinated.

items.title: Erosion & Washout Correction
items.body: We correct slope and runoff issues that contribute to washed-out gravel, exposed soil, and unstable edges.

factors.title: Extent of grading and slope correction
factors.body: The area that needs reshaping, how much cut and fill is required, and whether the grades tie into structures or existing base all affect scope.

factors.title: Swale, ditch, and drainage path work
factors.body: Cutting new drainage paths, reshaping existing ditches, or installing culverts adds machine time and material movement.

factors.title: Underground drainage pipe and stone
factors.body: Trenching, bedding, pipe, stone placement, and backfill add significant scope and cost to grading work that also needs subsurface drainage.

factors.title: Material import or haul-out
factors.body: Whether fill, stone, or granular base needs to be brought in, or whether excavated material needs to be trucked off, affects the total cost.

factors.title: Site access and working conditions
factors.body: Tight yards, soft ground, active construction areas, and proximity to structures all affect how the grading work can be done.

sections.heading: What This Work Helps Prevent
sections.subheading: Water problems get expensive when grading, pipe, stone, and access are treated as separate decisions.

items.problem: Poor slope can send water back toward buildings, garages, driveways, or finished yards.
items.solution: Bellhouse reshapes grades and drainage paths so runoff has a better route away from sensitive areas.

items.problem: Low spots can stay soft long after rain, making yards, lanes, and job sites difficult to use.
items.solution: Soft areas are reviewed for grade correction, drainage swales, stone, or underground drainage prep where appropriate.

items.problem: Driveways and gravel areas can wash out when runoff is not controlled before base material goes in.
items.solution: Grading and drainage are coordinated with granular placement so the finished surface has a stronger base and better water control.

items.question: Can you fix standing water in a yard or driveway?
items.answer: In many cases, yes. The right fix depends on slope, soil, where the water is coming from, and where it can drain. Bellhouse can review the site and recommend grading, swales, ditching, stone, or drainage prep where appropriate.

items.question: Do you install drain tile or underground drainage?
items.answer: We can handle excavation, pipe runs, stone bedding, backfill, and grading for underground drainage scopes where they fit the project. Drainage design and permits may still be required depending on the property and outlet.

items.question: Can grading help with driveway washouts?
items.answer: Yes. Driveway washouts often come from uncontrolled runoff, poor slope, or weak base material. Regrading, ditching, culverts, or better granular base may be part of the solution.

items.question: Do you work for homeowners and contractors?
items.answer: Yes. Bellhouse handles grading and drainage work for homeowners, builders, farms, and contractors across Brantford, Paris, Brant County, and nearby areas.
